summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a UK Regulatory Information Service announcement) disclosing PDMR dealings under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. On 24 September 2026, the company reported that CFO Dawn Allen acquired 2,317.19703 ordinary shares at 3.44631 pence and Brian McNamara acquired 12,208.83196 ordinary shares at 3.44631 pence plus 2,139.05113 ADSs at $9.3801, all via dividend reinvestment on 22 September 2026 on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine insider-holding notification, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor is named. No deal terms, valuation, premium or regulatory clock apply.
